description.p: DropTerm is a drop-down terminal for the COSMIC™ desktop in the Yakuake and Guake tradition: one keypress slides a full terminal overlay down from the top of the screen, the same keypress hides it again, and the shell session keeps running in between.

It supports multiple tabs with per-tab titles, launch profiles, theming that follows the COSMIC accent colors, a bell that surfaces as a desktop notification, and remote control over D-Bus — so a keyboard shortcut, a command, or the companion panel applet can all toggle the terminal.

New status band beneath the terminal — segments for the working path, git branch, profile, and more, with click-to-copy, text selection, and a right-click menu. The Profiles page gained explicit, transactional editing (Save/Cancel, a two-step delete, per-profile overrides), and the tab strip and status band each grew an optional hairline border.

Fixes: the window background follows the effective dark or light mode, profile commands run through the shell as a preamble, unspawnable programs degrade to a plain shell instead of a silent no-op, and every surface carries the app id so the shell never shows 'unknown'.
First release: drop-down terminal overlay, tabs and launch profiles, theming, bell notifications, D-Bus remote control, and the companion panel applet.
